title: Playboy March 1986 Sally Field Bunny Cover Interview Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge wear. The red and yellow line art on the cover is part of the original printed design. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, March 1986 issue, original $3.50 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover: Sally Field in a Playboy Bunny costume, with printed red and yellow line art. Also: Sally Field interview - from the heart; Lady D.J.s; How to Kiss a Girl; A Valentine to Bunnies; Can Jack Kemp Outplay Bill Bradley?; Men, Money and Dartmouth.

Back cover: Canadian Mist whisky ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
